english:
[Do not] boast... verse 6. "the kisses of an enemy."
Prophet Isaiah 40:16. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 21. "my prowess."
Epistle 2 Corinthians 11:21. "Brethren, to my shame..." to verse 29. "and I do not burn."
Alleluia of the Martyrs in the tone of the day.
Gospel Mark 6:45. "And immediately he constrained..." to 6:56. "were healed."

Tuesday. Of the Holy Virgins: Thecla, Barbara, and Pelagia.
Patristic Canon [Harts] of Martyrs.
Magnification [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [Dzk]: "In you boasts [the Church]."
Midday Liturgy Psalm 44 [45]. "They shall be brought to the king."
Book of Song of Songs 8:14. "Flee, my beloved..." to verse 14. "incorruptible body."
Prophet Isaiah 61:9. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 11. "all nations."
Catholic Epistle 1 Peter 5:8. "Be sober..." to verse 11. "forever. Amen."
Alleluia. "The queen shall stand."
Gospel Luke 12:32. "Do not fear..." to verse 40. "the Son of Man comes."

Wednesday. Patristic Canon [Harts] of Repentance.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 65 [66]. "Save your servants."
Epistle Galatians 1:1. "Paul, an apostle..." to verse 10. "I would not be a servant."
Alleluia in the tone of the day.
Gospel Mark 12:1. "And he began to speak in parables..." to verse 12. "and they went away."

Thursday. Of the Holy Saints: Panteleimon the physician, Hermolaus the priest, and Euprasxia the virgin.
Patristic Canon [Harts] of Martyrs.
Magnification [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 8 [Dzk]: "Memory of Christ."
Midday Liturgy Psalm 131 [132]. "Your priests."
Proverbs 4:20. "My son..." to verse 27. "shall direct [your ways]."
Prophet Jeremiah 15:19. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 20. "says the Lord [to you]."
Epistle 1 Corinthians 12:1. "Now concerning spiritual gifts..." to verse 7. "to each for profit."
Alleluia. "Your priests."
Gospel Matthew 9:35. "And Jesus went about..." to 10:1. "diseases."

Friday. Patristic Canon [Harts] of Rest.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 97 [98]. "All have seen."
Epistle Galatians 1:11. "I make known to you..." to verse 24. "God in me."
Alleluia in the tone of the day.
Gospel Mark 12:18. "Then come to him Sadducees..." to verse 34. "to ask him."

Saturday. Of the Holy Translating Doctors of ours: Mesrop, Elishe, Moses the Poet, David the Invincible Philosopher, Gregory of Narek, and Nerses of Kla.
Canticle Tone 2 [Ahk]: "Who adorned..." with its proper canons.
Magnification [Mankunk] and Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [By]: "Resembling Moses."
Midday Liturgy Psalm 14 [15]. "Those who fear the Lord."
Proverbs Wisdom 8:7. "If righteousness..." to verse 10. "and honor from the elders."
Prophet Amos 5:10 [translating the printed 00 as 10]. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 14. "God Almighty."
Epistle 1 Corinthians 12:4 [printed 5]. "Now there are diversities..." to verse 11. "as He wills."
Alleluia. "Your priests."
Gospel Matthew 7:6. "Do not give what is holy..." to verse 12. "and the prophets."

Fifth Sunday after the Holy Cross.
Patristic Canon [Harts] Tone 7 [Dzd]: "Who in the four-faced."
Magnificat [Metsatsoosce]: "Tabernacle of light."
Midday Liturgy Psalm 64 [65]. "Praise is due to you."
Prophet Isaiah 19:1. "Behold, the Lord..." to verse 11. "their counsel."
Epistle Galatians 2:1. "Then after fourteen years..." to verse 10. "to do the same."
Alleluia of the Resurrection in the tone of the day.
Gospel Mark 12:35. "And Jesus answered..." to verse 44. "all her living."

Monday. Of Saint Grigoris, Catholicos of Albania—Discovery of his relics—and the holy fathers Antony, Kronides, Tatul, Varus, Thomas, and the seven Herb-eaters, who were martyred at the monastery of Innakn.
Canticle Tone 8 [Dzk]: "True Root."
For the Patristic Canon [Harts] of the Grandchildren, say Tone 2 [Ahk]: "Who the divine light."
Magnification [Mankunk] Tone 8 [Dzk]: "Divine [faith]."
Dismissal [Hambartsi] Tone 3 [By]: "In these latter [times]."
Midday Introit: "Of the Hierarchs" and "Ascetics of Christ."
Hymn Tone 6 [Gk]: "Good Shepherd."
Psalm 131 [132]. "Your priests."
Prophet Jeremiah 33:14. "Behold, the days are coming..." to verse 22. "my ministers."
Prophet Isaiah 18:7. "In that time..." to verse 7. "mount Zion."
Epistle Hebrews 10:32. "But recall..." to verse 36 [printed 30]. "of the promise."
Alleluia. "Blessed are they."
Gospel Luke 10:21. "In that same hour..." to verse 24 [printed 23]. "and did not hear."
